hero.title: The moment the leaf opens
hero.subtitle: We source tea and ceremony tools from small growers and makers, and bring them to you exactly as they are.

philosophy.title: Slowness is not a delay. It is the point.
philosophy.body: Every tea here was chosen because it held our attention. Every bowl and pot was chosen because it was made by someone who still shapes clay by hand. We are not building a catalog. We are building a place to slow down.

If you have any questions about data protection, you can contact us at the email address above at any time.

sections.heading: 2. General information on data processing
sections.body:
We only process personal data of our users to the extent necessary to provide a functioning website and our content and services.

Processing of personal data regularly takes place only with the user's consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), to fulfil a contract or pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), or where necessary to safeguard our legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Personal data is deleted as soon as the purpose for storing it no longer applies, unless statutory retention obligations apply (e.g. German tax and commercial law retention periods of up to 10 years for order and invoice records under §§ 147 AO, 257 HGB).

sections.heading: 3. Provision of the website and creation of log files
sections.body:
When you visit our website, our hosting provider automatically collects information in so-called server log files that your browser transmits automatically. These are:

– IP address
– Date and time of the request
– Content of the request (specific page)
– Access status / HTTP status code
– Browser type and operating system
– Referrer URL

This data is not merged with other data sources. Collection takes place on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for the technical provision and security of the website. The data is automatically deleted after no more than [NUMBER] days.

Hosting provider: [NAME OF HOSTING PROVIDER, e.g. Vercel Inc.]. If the provider is based outside the EU/EEA, transfer takes place on the basis of Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent level of protection.

sections.heading: 4. Local storage (localStorage) for the shopping cart
sections.body:
Our shopping cart stores the items you select in your browser's local storage (localStorage), which is technically necessary. This data never leaves your device and is not transmitted to us until you submit an order. As this is a strictly necessary technical function, no consent under § 25 TTDSG is required.

You can clear this local storage at any time via your browser settings.

sections.heading: 5. Data processing when placing an order
sections.body:
When you place an order through our website, we collect and process the following data:

– Name
– Email address
– Phone number (optional)
– Delivery address (country, postal code, city, street, house number)
– Any note you add to the order
– Order content (selected items, quantity, price)

This processing takes place to carry out the ordering process and to fulfil the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Providing a phone number is optional and is used solely to make it easier to contact you about delivery questions.

Our website currently does not process online payments. Payment details will be sent to you afterwards by email.

Order data is stored in a database hosted by [NAME OF DATABASE PROVIDER] within the European Union. A data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with this provider.

Order data is retained in accordance with statutory retention periods (see section 2).

sections.heading: 6. Sending order confirmations by email
sections.body: To send order confirmations and payment information, we use [NAME OF EMAIL SERVICE PROVIDER, e.g. Resend/Brevo]. For this purpose, your email address and the content of your order are transmitted to the provider named above. A data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with this provider. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.

sections.heading: 7. Storage of product images
sections.body: Product images are delivered via Cloudflare R2 (Cloudflare, Inc.). No personal data about you is processed in this context; this solely concerns the technical delivery of static image files.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights as a data subject
sections.body:
You have the following rights:

– Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR)
– Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR)
– Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR)
– Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
– Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
– Right to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR)

To exercise these rights, an informal message to the email address given in section 1 is sufficient.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority regarding our processing of your personal data.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this privacy policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy to reflect changes in the law or in our offering. Your continued visit to the site is then subject to the updated privacy policy.
